name: Butyrfentanyl
summary: Potent short-acting opioid and fentanyl analogue. Often dispensed in a nasal spray. This is an highly potent drug - exercise extreme caution. May cause respiratory depression and death in overdose.
doseBasis: Note: The drug is reported to be potent, caution is recommended.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It is an agonist for the μ-opioid receptors.

uses.text: Butyrfentanyl has no current legitimate clinical applications; however, it is being sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea, and potentially serious respiratory depression which can be life-threatening.
